item.text: {"reviews":[{"benchmark":"arc","instrument_review":"MESA supports interpreting ARC-AGI-2 scores as performance on unfamiliar grid puzzles under specified conditions. Development checks, explicit scoring and marking tests support this use. Evidence remains incomplete for repeated-run stability, effects of changed testing conditions and broader intelligence claims. Missing evidence does not establish poor quality.","supported_claims":[{"claim":"Scores describe grid-puzzle performance under the stated scoring rules.","reason":"Exact matches receive credit per input, input results are averaged within problems, and problem scores are then averaged."},{"claim":"Problem selection included human testing and developer review.","reason":"Developers used a human puzzle-solving study, reviewed puzzles and removed repeated solution rules."},{"claim":"Some marking behavior was tested.","reason":"Public software tests cover correct answers, wrong dimensions, changed squares and missing outputs."},{"claim":"Verified evaluations have documented conditions and access safeguards.","reason":"ARC Prize specifies settings, spending limits, confidentiality rules and provider handling requirements."}],"documented_problems":[{"claim":"Some released puzzles required correction.","reason":"The change record lists fixes to coloured squares and unclear examples."},{"claim":"Verified testing does not average repeated runs.","reason":"The policy specifies one run."},{"claim":"A software problem score can differ from the description of a fully solved problem.","reason":"Solving one of two inputs earns 0.5, while fully solved requires every input to be correct."},{"claim":"Revisions are not accompanied by recalculation of every affected AI score.","reason":"The passage explicitly identifies this limit of the change record."}],"missing_information":[{"claim":"Repeated-run score variation and uncertainty estimates.","reason":"No estimates or ranges for repeated evaluations are supplied."},{"claim":"Effects of changed instructions, presentation or software.","reason":"No systematic study of these changes is supplied."},{"claim":"Evidence connecting scores to broader abilities.","reason":"No predictive study covers language, social interaction or real-world work."},{"claim":"Complete evidence for comparability across testing routes and revisions.","reason":"Other routes may use different conditions, and not every affected historical score is recalculated."}],"reinterpretations":[{"term":"AI","meaning":"For verified comparisons, the evaluated AI is the configured system operating under recorded settings and a spending limit; results from other testing routes may describe different conditions."},{"term":"Reasoning","meaning":"The directly observed outcome is successful completion of two-dimensional grid puzzles; broader reasoning and intelligence remain proposed interpretations."},{"term":"Problem solved","meaning":"The software permits fractional problem credit, while the dataset description reserves fully solved for correct outputs on every new input."}],"closing_note":"The assigned method is understood to be MESA. The questions are usable, but testing that occurred must be distinguished from comprehensive validation, and missing evidence from evidence of failure.","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The public ARC-AGI-2 test, official software and score calculation are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Rule inference, AI-system comparisons and broader reasoning ambitions are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Worked grid pairs, new inputs and required exact output grids are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Verified tests specify settings, spending limits and two attempts per input; other routes are distinguished."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Exact-match credit and averaging within and across problems are explained."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Inferring new rules from examples is explicitly linked to the intended reasoning ability."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Human difficulty testing and rule-diversity checks justify selection, but do not establish representation of broader reasoning."},{"id":8,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Human solving and developer review checked puzzle examples and solutions; later corrections show these checks were not error-free."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Rule diversity supports coverage within grid puzzles; broader intelligence is not covered."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exact grid correctness reflects successful completion, but does not establish which reasoning process produced it."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The averaging rule is clear, but evidence justifying its interpretation as an ability measure is not supplied."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public marking tests cover several correct and incorrect response cases; complete validation is not established."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"AI results and human difficulty data provide context, but the human study used a larger pool and other AI testing routes may differ."},{"id":14,"choice":"No","comment":"The specified verified-testing policy uses one run rather than repeated runs."},{"id":15,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No systematic study of changed instructions, presentation or software is supplied."},{"id":16,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Score-variation estimates or ranges supporting comparisons are not supplied."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Developers considered program-search shortcuts and repeated solution rules, without ruling out every unintended route."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exposure monitoring and provider agreements address hidden tests; public exposure and possible leakage remain."},{"id":19,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Development training is allowed, evaluation-specific adaptation is discouraged, and verified feedback is restricted to preserve evaluation separation."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No study links scores to broader real-world abilities."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Verified tests record settings, but other testing routes can differ; human background findings do not establish AI fairness."},{"id":22,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public problems, running software and marking tests permit inspection of the specified public evaluation; hidden tests remain controlled."},{"id":23,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public licensing and hidden-data confidentiality, handling and code-review rules are stated."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Dated corrections and code changes are recorded, but effects on all historical scores are not calculated."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid-performance claims are supported; connections to broader intelligence remain unestablished."}]},{"benchmark":"designqa","instrument_review":"MESA supports using DesignQA to examine performance on its engineering-document tasks under the reported information conditions. Practical materials and some development and marking checks support that interpretation. Uneven task coverage, wording-sensitive scoring and differences in supplied information limit broader competence claims and fine model rankings.","supported_claims":[{"claim":"The tasks reflect specified parts of engineering-document work.","reason":"Questions use competition rules, vehicle designs and test data to assess six described task types."},{"claim":"Some development and marking checks occurred.","reason":"Additional reviewers checked manually written questions with exceptions, and small scoring tests and scoring-error discussions are reported."},{"claim":"Effects of some changes to the testing setup were examined.","reason":"The paper studies supplied passages, dimension labels, scale bars and highlighted images."},{"claim":"Public materials support partial inspection.","reason":"Questions, instructions, scoring code and some AI responses are available."}],"documented_problems":[{"claim":"Coverage is narrow and uneven.","reason":"One rulebook supplies the context, and group sizes range from 1,192 questions to 16."},{"claim":"Wording and formatting can affect credit independently of engineering correctness.","reason":"Examples involve missing commas and valid related rules omitted from reference answers."},{"claim":"Systems receive different information.","reason":"Some receive the whole rulebook while others receive retrieved passages."},{"claim":"One portion permits a constant-answer shortcut.","reason":"All described scale-bar drawings comply, so always answering yes would earn their decision credit; this does not show any AI used that strategy."},{"claim":"The released materials do not fully reconstruct every reported result.","reason":"Historical software, settings and inputs are incompletely linked, and one answer file has fewer rows than the paper's question count."}],"missing_information":[{"claim":"Comprehensive marking accuracy and consistency evidence.","reason":"Small tests and scoring discussions do not establish a complete validation study."},{"claim":"Identical-condition repeated runs and adequate uncertainty for close comparisons.","reason":"The five passage sets change the inputs, and main comparison information is insufficient for small differences."},{"claim":"A systematic exposure assessment and clear evaluation-training policies.","reason":"No protected test set, systematic overlap check or clear repeated-submission rules were established."},{"claim":"Evidence of performance beyond the supplied engineering tasks.","reason":"Transfer to other technical documents and real projects remains uncertain."},{"claim":"Complete reuse rules and score-impact documentation for revisions.","reason":"The inspected sources lack a licence file, complete responsible-reuse rules and a clear explanation of revision effects on scores."}],"reinterpretations":[{"term":"AI","meaning":"Reported performance describes the AI together with its information supply, including whether it receives the full rulebook or retrieved passages."},{"term":"Engineering understanding","meaning":"Scores operationalize performance on six task groups from one competition context; broader engineering competence is not established."},{"term":"Overall score","meaning":"The software equally weights six groups with different sizes and marking methods; the result is not established as a distinct underlying skill measure."}],"closing_note":"MESA is the assigned method. Some questions combine several requirements, so partial support is distinguished from missing information. Changed-passage testing does not count as repetition under identical conditions.","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The original 2024 benchmark, 1,451 question-answer pairs and public scoring methods are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Engineering-document abilities, tested AI systems and intended comparisons are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Six task groups, supplied materials and required text or yes/no responses are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Instructions, settings and differences in supplied information are described, though historical reconstruction is incomplete."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Text comparison, decision credit, explanation scoring and equal group weighting are explained."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors connect tasks to finding, interpreting and applying engineering rules in practical work."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Real materials and practitioner contributions support relevance; one rulebook and uneven groups limit broader representation."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Additional reviews occurred, with exceptions and more limited checks of some explanations."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Six task types cover parts of the intended ability, but engineering work across documents and industries is not represented."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Correct decisions receive credit, but formatting and incomplete reference answers can distort marks."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Equal group weighting is described, but its interpretation and distinct skill meanings lack supporting evidence."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Small marking-test files and discussion of scoring failures show testing occurred; comprehensive validation is not established."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Random guessing and AI comparisons provide context, but information supply differs and no engineer baseline is reported."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Five different passage sets do not establish repeated testing under identical conditions."},{"id":15,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Changes to passages, labels, scale bars and highlighting were examined."},{"id":16,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Passage variation gives limited information, but uncertainty for close main-model comparisons remains insufficient."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Formatting, retrieval and component familiarity were considered, but unintended scoring routes were not fully tested."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Image novelty and possible exposure were discussed; systematic overlap checking and a protected set were not established."},{"id":19,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Clear rules and justifications for test-specific training and repeated submissions were unavailable."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Practical relevance does not establish predictive performance on other documents or engineering projects."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Information differences are documented, but they complicate comparisons of the AI systems themselves."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public materials permit inspection, but incomplete historical records prevent repetition of every result."},{"id":23,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"A licence file and complete responsible-reuse rules were not found; this does not establish that reuse is prohibited."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Code history identifies revisions, but their effects on scores lack a clear change record."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The paper acknowledges narrow coverage and marking limits; broader competence claims and close rankings need additional support."}]}]}
